subject: SAC-B3 provenance-bearing policy-bounded exact-feature projection bias

policy.capacityInvariant: Dimensions, Fanout, and Active are unchanged; bias only changes competition within the existing sparse capacity.
policy.implementation: Rules are validated and cloned at Provider construction, compiled into an exact-selector map once, and applied in place to request-owned prepared features.

syntheticFixtures.observation: The exact rare provenance prior raises the shared critical feature into the sparse winner set and reverses the synthetic baseline miss without increasing the unrelated candidate in this fixture.

A provenance-bearing but semantically poor caller policy can still create false activation by boosting a common feature. Provenance and hard bounds provide auditability and containment, not policy correctness.

standaloneGoReconstruction.method: Standalone deterministic Go reconstruction of the current hash/projection algorithm, SUI-shaped feature extraction, exact-selector bias, and the B3 fixtures.

benchmark.interpretation: The reconstruction shows no additional allocation count for in-place bias application. Exact-selector map lookup adds a modest CPU delta in this synthetic preparation path; this is not an exact repository benchmark.
